description: Source code for URLRequestRedirectJob class handling HTTP redirect logic in Chromium's net module.

classes.name: URLRequestRedirectJob
classes.description: Handles HTTP redirect responses within Chromium's network stack, managing redirect info, headers, and asynchronous start.

methods.name: URLRequestRedirectJob
methods.description: Constructor initializing redirect job with request, destination, response code, and reason.

methods.name: GetResponseInfo
methods.description: Fills HttpResponseInfo with synthesized headers and timing info.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Sets load timing metrics for the redirect response.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the redirect process, posting StartAsync to the task runner.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Invalidates weak pointers and kills the job.

methods.name: CopyFragmentOnRedirect
methods.description: Determines if URL fragment should be copied on redirect; returns false.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous start, synthesizes headers, logs, and notifies headers complete.

methods.name: SetRequestHeadersCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to handle request headers.
